svg.title: LinkedIn Jobs Pipeline — Full Architecture with CI/CD
svg.desc: Full data pipeline with GitHub Actions CI/CD at the top deploying Lambda 1a and 1c. EventBridge triggers Discovery and Snapshot processes every 6 hours. Lambdas write to S3 bronze, Glue Workflows transform through silver to gold, EC2 serves the Plotly Dash public dashboard.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do I structure the GitHub repo for two Lambda functions with separate GitHub Actions workflows?')
sendPrompt('Show me the GitHub Actions workflow YAML for deploying Lambda functions to AWS')
sendPrompt('How does EventBridge Scheduler trigger the pipeline every 6 hours?')
sendPrompt('What does Lambda 1a the Discovery scraper do?')
sendPrompt('What does Lambda 1b the Snapshot Orchestrator do?')
g.text: reads active job URLs from gold

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What is stored in the S3 bronze discovery layer?')
sendPrompt('What does Lambda 1c the batch Job Fetcher do?')
sendPrompt('Walk me through Glue Workflow A the Discovery pipeline step by step')
sendPrompt('What is stored in the S3 bronze snapshots layer?')
sendPrompt('Walk me through Glue Workflow B the Snapshot pipeline step by step')
sendPrompt('What is in the S3 gold layer and how does Plotly Dash read it?')
sendPrompt('How do I deploy Plotly Dash on EC2 with gunicorn and nginx?')
sendPrompt('How do I set up a public domain with Route 53 and Elastic IP?')
